AI OUTFIT CHECK

Get a Second Opinion on Your Outfit

Already dressed but not sure if the outfit works? AURSA gives you a personalized second opinion on the look you're wearing so you can understand what's working and decide with more confidence.

What can AURSA help with?

  • Understanding Visual Balance — See whether colors, proportions, and layering feel harmonious.
  • Gaining Another Perspective — Get objective, non-judgmental feedback standing at the mirror.
  • Noticing Small Adjustments — Discover subtle tweaks to refine your look.
  • Deciding with Clarity — Step out knowing why your outfit works.

How do you use it?

  1. Share Your Look — Share the outfit you are currently wearing.
  2. Second Opinion — Receive an instant, personalized second opinion.
  3. Review Feedback — Understand what's working and what you may adjust.
  4. Step Out — Make your own decision and wear with confidence.

When is an outfit check useful?

Before going out, dates, job interviews, work, weddings, events, or when shopping alone.

Not a fashion judge.

AURSA is not designed to tell you that your personal style is right or wrong. It gives you another perspective on the outfit you're already wearing so you can decide for yourself.
